transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Leah, the Talent Booker for ScreenSound Expo. Before I lock the guest appearance package for Mara Vale's 6:20 PM filmed conversation in the Meridian Hall, I'd like to go through the final round of reports from each functional lead. Could everyone share any changes or updates to the draft event plan so we're all aligned before I make the binding decision?

transcript.text: I have an update from Mara's agent. I confirmed with them this morning that Mara is only available from 6:20 PM to 6:55 PM, she requires a seated two-chair interview format, she will not take audience questions, and she will not permit photography. The agent's confirmation is still in my inbox and hasn't been entered into the show file yet, so the draft plan needs to be revised on all of those points.
